rationale: No workflow_yaml optimization has all prerequisites met for this build-and-deploy workflow. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) is already implemented via the yarn cache directory plus actions/cache steps, so there is nothing to add there. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is the closest fit and has measured experiment evidence, but its precondition—representative successful-duration history—is not met: the repository's recorded CI runs are all failures (not_a_measured_baseline), and this is a deployment workflow that pushes to gh-pages using a token, where an arbitrary timeout could interrupt valid slow runs (documented contraindication). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is meaningless for a single-job matrix (only ubuntu-latest), and P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated for deployment work. The remaining patterns (test selection/prioritization, Bazel, scheduled-workflow suppression) do not apply to this workflow. Existing build and test coverage is preserved, so no change is supported.
